audits.title: Audit on clozapine dose and plasma level correlation for patients with chronic treatment-resistant psychosis
audits.standard: MHRA guidance that clozapine levels should be monitored in clinical situations where toxicity may be suspected
audits.setting: Nottingham City Central Local Mental Health Team (community)

cycle1.period: Plasma levels 2006 to 2020; doses from 2018 onwards
cycle1.result: 273 clozapine levels taken; mean interval between levels 10 months 2 weeks (range 2 days to 13 years); 88 levels >600 ug/L and 108 levels <350 ug/L; 32% of levels above recommended range; non-significant positive dose-level trend (R = 0.37)

audits.other_findings: No routine clozapine level monitoring found; unclear whether levels were trough levels.
audits.citation: Macnamara O, Lawton J, Lankappa S. Audit on clozapine dose and plasma level correlation for patients with chronic treatment-resistant psychosis. BJPsych Open. 2021;7(S1):S90-S90. doi:10.1192/bjo.2021.273.

audits.title: Clozapine Serum Level Timing Audit: Medium Secure Rowan View
audits.standard: Maudsley Prescribing Guidelines 14th edition and Synnovis guidance: clozapine level taken 12 hours post dose

cycle1.result: Samples >15 hours post dose: OD 56.3% (31/55), BD pm evening/night 25% (3/12), TDS 16.7% (2/12), BD am/nocte 12.9% (9/62). Samples >12 hours: OD 63.6%, BD am/nocte 51.6%, BD pm 75%, TDS 41.7%.

audits.intervention: Planned: informing teams of recent samples >15 hours post dose, service education and guideline change with pharmacy support.
audits.other_findings: Timing inaccuracy was greatest with bespoke regimes; Maudsley guidance does not address bespoke dose timings. Re-audit planned in 12 months.
audits.citation: Daniels C. Clozapine Serum Level Timing Audit: Medium Secure Rowan View. BJPsych Open. 2023;9(S1):S153-S153. doi:10.1192/bjo.2023.412.

audits.title: Monitoring of Blood Clozapine Levels After a Change in Smoking Status for Patients Treated With Clozapine: A Clinical Audit From Hull Community Mental Health Team
audits.standard: MHRA Drug Safety Update August 2020: check clozapine levels when smoking status changes
audits.setting: East and West Hull community mental health teams

cycle1.result: Clozapine level checked after smoking change in 42.86%; medical review after change in 19%.

audits.intervention: Recommended: clozapine level within a week and medical review within two weeks of a change, and a smoking status section on the electronic clozapine monitoring form.
audits.other_findings: 58 smokers on clozapine were identified, with 21 documented changes in smoking status.
audits.citation: Mahmood K, Anakebe O, Theobalds-Ward K, Gulati M. Monitoring of Blood Clozapine Levels After a Change in Smoking Status for Patients Treated With Clozapine: A Clinical Audit From Hull Community Mental Health Team. BJPsych Open. 2024;10(S1):S247-S248. doi:10.1192/bjo.2024.600.

audits.title: Audit of the Management of High Clozapine Levels Within Solihull Community Mental Health Teams (CMHTs)
audits.standard: BSMHFT clozapine guideline (January 2023): levels >600mcg/L assessed for toxicity and dose reduction considered; >1000mcg/L reviewed urgently
audits.setting: Solihull community mental health teams, Birmingham and Solihull Mental Health Foundation Trust

cycle1.result: 24 had levels >600mcg/L, of whom 16 (67%) were screened for toxicity; 11 had levels >1000mcg/L, of whom 9 (82%) were screened.

audits.intervention: Flow chart summarising the updated clozapine guidelines to prompt toxicity review.
audits.citation: O'Connor S, Hashmat H. Audit of the Management of High Clozapine Levels Within Solihull Community Mental Health Teams (CMHTs). BJPsych Open. 2024;10(S1):S252-S252. doi:10.1192/bjo.2024.609.

audits.title: Clinical Audit of Initial Plasma Monitoring of Clozapine and Lithium Across Inpatient Psychiatric Wards
audits.standard: Trust guidelines: clozapine levels pre-morning dose or 10–12 h post-dose after at least 3 days on stable dose; lithium levels 5–7 days after initiation, 12–14 h post-dose, weekly until stable. Target 100%
audits.setting: Eight inpatient psychiatric wards, Tees, Esk and Wear Valleys NHS Foundation Trust

cycle1.result: Clozapine (n=6): all had levels after at least 3 days on stable dose; 4 (66.67%) sampled within recommended post-dose window; 2 (33.33%) unconfirmed due to missing lab reports. Lithium (n=9): 7 (77.8%) checked within 5–7 days of initiation; 2 sampled outside 12–14 h window. Overall 66.67% fully monitored in line with guidelines.

audits.intervention: Planned: guidelines displayed on wards, targeted teaching, patient education, accountability for uploading clozapine monitoring forms, work with IT on report uploads
audits.other_findings: Missing clozapine monitoring forms limited assessment of compliance. Re-audit planned.
audits.citation: Oo E, Adenle S. Clinical Audit of Initial Plasma Monitoring of Clozapine and Lithium Across Inpatient Psychiatric Wards. BJPsych Open. 2026;12(S1):S331-S331. doi:10.1192/bjo.2026.11812.
